messages.en:
{07 13 00}I used to think long walks

{07 15 00}'Til I got one foot caught{01 00 00 05 00}
in some driftwood, and the
other in something slimy.
{07 19 00}It just reaffirmed my
belief that sitting around
is always the best policy.

{07 13 00}Varem arvasin, et pikad

{07 19 00}See kinnitas mu usku, et
niisama istumine on alati
parim poliitika.
